codeBlock.description: A source-owned code surface for highlighted files, diffs, patches, merge conflicts, streams, SSR, Workers, and editing.
codeBlock.annotationExample: This line returns the user-visible status.
codeBlock.interactionHint: Click a line number to select it, or click a token to inspect it.
codeBlock.fileDescription: File name, language, contents, and optional cache key.
codeBlock.optionsDescription: Highlighting, line-number, overflow, theme, selection, and render options.
codeBlock.appearanceDescription: Visual preset applied to the code surface.
codeBlock.themeDescription: Color-scheme resolution for this code surface.
codeBlock.toolbarDescription: Shows the copy and line-wrapping toolbar, replaceable with a custom header.
codeBlock.messagesDescription: Overrides toolbar, copy-state, and accessible-label text.
codeBlock.editDescription: Starts an edit session when a CodeEditProvider is present.
codeBlock.annotationDescription: Typed file or line annotations rendered through slots.
codeBlock.highlightFeedbackDescription: Show loading and retry feedback in the default toolbar.
codeBlock.highlightTimeoutDescription: Async highlight deadline in milliseconds; 0 disables the deadline.
codeBlock.highlightRetryDescription: Change this value to retry the current failed highlight without remounting.
codeBlock.highlightStateDescription: Receive loading, ready, plain, or error after the corresponding content is committed.
